finding: No exact source for the proved exponent-two normal-node kernel theorem was located. Broad results were mostly unrelated; Uchida's 1967 Remarks on Grothendieck Rings is a primary historical pointer for regular-domain results, not a source used for this theorem.

primary_pointer.title: Koji Uchida, Remarks on Grothendieck Rings
primary_pointer.status: Original eight-page PDF opened and read 2026-11-19T18:14:25Z; regular-domain prime-characteristic G0 statements and order example do not provide the singular mixed-characteristic lattice criterion. Unused for the node theorem.
primary_pointer.exact_scope: Theorems1-2 pp343-344; Section2 pp344-345; G(A) is the Grothendieck group of all finite modules, as defined p341.
